entries.verified: CTO-16 Antigravity §4, read 2026-11-01: by default the agent reads and writes files inside the project without asking; allowNonWorkspaceAccess is off by default.
CTO-16 Antigravity §4, read 2026-11-01: writing in the workspace decides nobody (no asking) by default.
CTO-16 Antigravity §4, read 2026-11-01: allowNonWorkspaceAccess defaults off, so writing outside the workspace is not allowed without it.
CTO-16 Antigravity §4, read 2026-11-01: toolPermission default request-review — every command asks for approval (decider user).
CTO-16 Antigravity §4, read 2026-11-01: read_url, execute_url and MCP ask by default.
CTO-16 Antigravity §4, read 2026-11-01: MCP tool calls ask by default.
CTO-16 Antigravity §4, read 2026-11-01: toolPermission default request-review; agentMode default; artifactReviewPolicy asks-for-review.
